variables.body:
if ($ctrl.storedTab === 2) {
    if ($ctrl.selectedType === "REGULAR") $ctrl.filteredTableData = $ctrl.tableData.filter((row) =>
        $ctrl.paySchedules.find(paySchedule => $ctrl.payPeriods.find(payPeriod => payPeriod.Id === row.PayPeriodId).PayScheduleId === paySchedule.Id).CompanyId === $ctrl.globalSelectedCompany.companyId && row.RunType === "REGULAR"
            ? $ctrl.selectedPayPeriod ? row.PayPeriodId === $ctrl.selectedPayPeriod && Object.values(row).some((value) =>
                String(value)
                    .toLowerCase()
                    .includes($ctrl.filterTarget.toLowerCase()))
                : $ctrl.selectedPaySchedule ? $ctrl.payPeriods.find(payPeriod => payPeriod.Id === row.PayPeriodId).PayScheduleId === $ctrl.selectedPaySchedule &&
                    Object.values(row).some((value) =>
                        String(value)
                            .toLowerCase()
                            .includes($ctrl.filterTarget.toLowerCase()))

                    : Object.values(row).some((value) =>
                        String(value)
                            .toLowerCase()
                            .includes($ctrl.filterTarget.toLowerCase()))
            : null
    );

    else $ctrl.filteredTableData = $ctrl.tableData.filter((row) =>
        (row.OffCycle) || (row.RunType === $ctrl.selectedType)
            ? Object.values(row).some((value) =>
                String(value)
                    .toLowerCase()
                    .includes($ctrl.filterTarget.toLowerCase()))
            : null
    );
} else $ctrl.filteredTableData = $ctrl.tableData.filter((row) =>
    row.Detail.CompanyId === $ctrl.globalSelectedCompany.companyId || row.Entity === "Deduction" || row.Entity === "Tax"
        ? Object.values(row).some((value) =>
            String(value)
                .toLowerCase()
                .includes($ctrl.filterTarget.toLowerCase()))
        : null
);
